source_changes.owner_scope: Only _plan_turn_internal and _plan_turn_internal_without_readonly_retry_v1 in canonical Service, one new pure helper and independent tests. M4 family methods, M6 camera/test, runtime factories and frozen SDKs unchanged.
source_changes.method_signature: Private optional _planner_remainder_v1=None on both internal methods; existing public/Driver/MCP arguments unchanged.
source_changes.default_path: Absent _planner_remainder_timing_enabled_v1 or any value other than True preserves original call path. Enabled without callable observer also preserves original path. No helper import, clock, observer, new log/file/format/env read on the default path.
enable_for_future_software_host_only: Set service._planner_remainder_observer_v1 to a memory-only collector such as rows.append.
Outer wrapper creates one counter; all read-only retry attempts and explicitly recursive replans forward that local counter.
Default helper parameter enabled=False. No current SDK/host admission was changed.
source_changes.observer_contract: One finally-delivered numeric memory summary per outer call, including an exception path. No new formatter/logger/sink or automatic I/O. The receiver owns any authorized persistence and machine/request metadata binding.
source_changes.scope: Single outer call only; no service/global counter storage or business/frame cache.
source_changes.labels_are_inclusive: Nested callee durations and outer elapsed are not additive; neither keys nor observations replace existing interval-union accounting.
source_changes.result_and_error_contract: Each selected original callable executes exactly once with original evaluated arguments, returned object and original exception identity preserved. Observer/clock failures only lose timing; they never convert a completed action to unknown or request a business replay.
source_changes.clock_failure_contract: Missing/noninteger/backward clock samples are counted and discarded; elapsed may be null. The real clock is perf_counter_ns; only tests inject clocks.
source_changes.budget: Pure per-call integer dictionaries,16 measured source sites and1 recursive forwarding site. No unbounded trace list, deep copy, payload serialization, hashing, history scan, Game query or cross-frame cache added.
